model: nominal state-machine replay, not measured timing
assumptions: Nominal replay of sensor.c, not instruction-accurate FW execution or measured peripheral timing.
IO writes spaced by 100 ns, main/DMA latency zero, ADC conversion 500 ns: placeholders, not TI guarantees.
Digital edges 5 ns and output resistance 33 ohm are placeholders, not an IBIS model.
DAC uses ideal code*VREF/4096, a 1 us linear ramp and 100 ohm output resistance; not a settling/glitch model.
3.3 V is an assumed board supply/reference. MCU supply current and package/PDN effects are not modeled.
Start delay 100 us and frame gap 10 us are analysis scenario values; no boot/PLL timing or UART traffic is replayed.
Changing timings/codes changes the analysis scenario only; it does not update FW automatically.
Demo RC loads and transient step are for connectivity smoke testing, not validated EMI analysis.
